items.title: Which current animal names link to more than one record?
assumptions: Names were compared after Unicode NFC normalization, case folding, and removal of spaces and invisible format characters.
A name shared by multiple species can be a legitimate broad common name, but it is unsafe for a router that must select exactly one animal record.

source.label: Wildlife database
filters: Canonical Myanmar names, English names, scientific names, and saved aliases
Names linked to more than one animal ID
caveats: This is an exact normalized-name audit; it does not classify merely similar spellings as conflicts.

evidenceFlow.title: Coverage check
evidenceFlow.detail: The audit checked 123 animal records and 764 canonical-name or alias links.

evidenceFlow.title: Conflict count
evidenceFlow.detail: Eight names were linked to multiple animal IDs, affecting 18 animal records.
